# Go codegen for $"..." translatable strings: per-locale i18n.Translate wiring.

sngl generate --platform=bubbletea --lang=go --out=out app.sngl
exists out/model.go

# i18n runtime package is imported (no alias needed; last path segment is "i18n").
grep '"git.duckfam.us/jonathan/sngl/pkg/go/i18n"' out/model.go

# Static string $"Login" compiles to i18n.Translate(locale, key, inlined, args)
# with key == inlinedTemplate and locale read from the component's hidden
# __ctx_locale Model field (NoContext lowers context reads to a Var on the
# component, initialized to i18n.DefaultLocale() in New()).
grep 'm.__ctx_locale = i18n.DefaultLocale\(\)' out/model.go
grep 'i18n.Translate\(m.__ctx_locale, "Login", "Login",' out/model.go

# Empty args map is emitted for static strings with no placeholders.
grep 'map\[string\]any{}' out/model.go

# Translatable string with placeholder: args map contains the placeholder binding.
grep '"Hello, \{user\}!"' out/model.go
grep '"user":' out/model.go

# The alias a program imports i18n under is not part of the entry point's
# identity: the mark on the declaration is. Detection keyed on a receiver
# named "i18n" would leave this build with no runtime import and no manifest.
sngl generate --platform=bubbletea --lang=go --out=outalias alias.sngl
grep '"git.duckfam.us/jonathan/sngl/pkg/go/i18n"' outalias/model.go
grep 'i18n.NumberInt\(m.__ctx_locale, ' outalias/model.go

-- alias.sngl --
import . "sngl:std"
import t "sngl:i18n"

output { go { bubbletea } }

component main {
    var n int = 1234
    var s = t.numberInt(n, "decimal")
    text(value=s)
}
-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:std"
import "sngl:i18n"

output { go { bubbletea } }

component main {
    var greeting = $"Login"
    var user = "alice"
    var hello = $"Hello, {user}!"
    text(value=greeting)
    text(value=hello)
}
